blind.description: A stylized bird nest crafted from woven brown twigs and orange straw, containing three small pale feather or leaf accents tucked around the rim. Resting centrally inside the nest is a single upright speckled egg with a cream base and mottled red, purple, and blue spots. The surfaces are solid, stylized, and continuous with no floating, melted, or missing geometry.
blind.from_above: A concentric circular nest of brown and orange woven twigs with a speckled egg centered in the cup and three small pale feather tips distributed around the rim.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.2 feet tall (roughly one-fifth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 1.8 feet wide.
